signals.title: Further Finnish data-centre plans: Riihimäki, Kuusamo, Laihia
signals.detail: DCD, via a search summary, reports Northern Europe Energy targeting a Riihimäki data centre, with Kuusamo and Laihia in preparation. Other large plans reported: Nebius 310 MW in Lappeenranta, Cerebras 165 MW in Mikkeli, atNorth EUR 2bn in Salo. These are not verified individually.

signals.title: Finnish building permits: data-centre boom lifts non-residential, housing falls
signals.detail: September 2026: permit volume +27%, non-residential +37%, residential -12%, 15,885 dwellings (-13%).

signals.title: Stoa raises EUR 3.5M pre-seed for AI on construction sites (Helsinki)
signals.detail: Led by Lifeline Ventures. Data-centre focus. Shows Nordic seed capital for construction AI.

signals.title: Helsinki AI-for-construction startup Stoa raises EUR 3.5M pre-seed
signals.detail: Led by Lifeline Ventures, with Illusian and Wave Ventures. Angels include the PlanGrid co-founders, former Nokia CEO Pekka Lundmark and SRV board member Tuomas Kokkila. Stoa's AI platform combines drawings, schedules, and quality and safety reports, with cited answers. The company says it is used on more than 25 Nordic sites and focuses on data-centre projects. The headline says $3.9M and the body says EUR 3.5M. The likely legal entity is Stoa Technologies Oy (3633842-5, registered 23 June 2026). No Aalto link is stated.

signals.title: Zacua Ventures closes $135M Fund II for construction tech
signals.detail: LPs include Volvo Group, Holcim, Hilti and Trimble.

signals.title: Statistics Finland: construction turnover +13.2% in September
signals.detail: Specialised construction +20.7%, buildings +5.1%, civil engineering +10.0%. Confirms the Eurostat output figures.

signals.title: EIC Accelerator 2027 opens for short proposals; EIC 2027 work programme reported adopted
signals.detail: The EU portal shows the EIC Accelerator 2027 short-proposal topic open since 10 November 2026, and Pathfinder Open (EUR 166M) opening 25 November 2026 with a first-stage deadline of 25 February 2027. Third-party summaries of the work programme (not checked against the official text) report EUR 1.816 billion in total, four Accelerator full-proposal cut-offs in 2027 (20 January, 17 March, 1 September, 4 November) and a EUR 50M Accelerator Challenge on climate-neutral and smart cities covering buildings, mobility and resource management.

signals.title: EU water digitalisation action plan: stakeholder roundtable held, adoption now expected in first half of 2027
signals.detail: Commissioner Roswall hosted utilities, industry and research organisations on 9 November to discuss the outline of the action plan. Earlier reporting aimed for publication in Q4 2026, so the timing has slipped. The Commission estimates smart meters can save up to 25% of water and leak detection 7-14%. Industry (Xylem, Veolia, Suez, Siemens) asks for financing and procurement guidelines; utilities want interoperability and cybersecurity first.

signals.title: Archiboost AI raises $6.2M pre-seed and seed for AI review of construction drawings
signals.detail: San Francisco startup; round led by Hanabi Capital and Marathon Venture Capital. Listed in the weekly construction-tech roundup together with Shackleton AI ($5M seed led by Battery Ventures, out of stealth 4 November). The roundup reported no acquisitions and no European construction-tech rounds for the week.

signals.title: EU housing agenda: EESC conference calls for supply measures; housing ministers to meet 25-26 November
signals.detail: The EESC and Eurofound conference in Dublin cited a 55% average rise in property prices and 27% in rents since 2010. The Affordable Housing Act was proposed in September 2026, an EESC opinion on it is expected in December 2026, an informal housing ministers' meeting is scheduled for 25-26 November 2026 and a Housing Simplification Package is planned for 2027.

signals.title: Commission discusses EU water-sector digitalisation action plan
signals.detail: The plan is due in the first half of 2027. It is expected to back smart metering and leak detection.

signals.title: Aalto ranked third in Europe for spin-out funding
signals.detail: An Aalto news item (Swedish version) says Aalto ranked third among European universities for spin-out funding, behind Oxford and Cambridge, in the first half of 2026. I could not confirm the exact wording or date from the translated page.

signals.title: Forecast: European spending on digital water to grow 121% by 2036
signals.detail: The forecast is driven by metering and analytics. Network and plant management makes up almost half of projected spend, and the UK leads growth. Read from search summaries only; the article returned 403 and the forecaster and absolute values were not verified.

signals.title: Skanska Q3 2026: record backlog
signals.detail: Backlog SEK 328.3 billion, revenue SEK 49.4 billion, operating income SEK 2.1 billion (+52%), slightly below consensus.

signals.title: NCC wins SEK 260M data-centre preparatory works at Pori
signals.detail: Works for ASP DC, completing in spring 2027.

signals.title: Shackleton exits stealth with $5M seed
signals.detail: AI construction startup Shackleton launched an agentic operating system for construction with a $5M seed led by Battery Ventures. I only have a search summary of this, not the primary article.

signals.title: Horizon AI, Data and Robotics partnership call opens
signals.detail: Call HORIZON-CL4-2024-DIGITAL-EMERGING-01-04 opened on 2026-11-04 with a deadline of 2027-01-27. It is a general AI and robotics call that could fit construction robotics and data. Fit with the sector has not been checked in detail.

signals.title: Reported pause of two Google data-centre builds in Finland over forest clearing
signals.detail: Baxtel reportedly said in October 2026 that two Google sites were paused after a 300-hectare forest clearing. This came from a secondary search summary and I did not verify it. It is a permitting and reputation risk for the pipeline.

signals.title: YIT Q3 2026: revenue +14%, record order book, data centres named fastest-growing business (published before the last update, first captured now)
signals.detail: Q3 revenue EUR 530M (466M), adjusted operating profit EUR 30M (24M); January-September revenue EUR 1,400M (+7%). Order book EUR 3,448M (2,929M a year earlier). 2026 adjusted operating profit guidance narrowed to EUR 80-90M. YIT sees a path to about EUR 1 billion data-centre revenue in 2029, conditional on power availability and customer investment. Finnish apartment sales are not expected to grow in 2026.

signals.title: KONE Q3 2026: orders +7.2%, sales +5.2%, guidance raised (published before the last update, first captured now)
signals.detail: Q3 orders received EUR 2,292.9M and sales EUR 2,906.0M; adjusted EBIT EUR 369.0M (12.7% of sales). 2026 sales growth guidance raised to 4-6% at comparable rates. Secondary summaries say service and modernisation were about 65% of Q3 sales and China new building remained weak. The planned combination with TK Elevator received its first regulatory clearances.

signals.title: Finland has 145 announced data-centre projects, 60 of them this year
signals.detail: Yle reports 145 planned projects nationwide (60 announced this year, 50 in 2025). New projects are moving north because city grids are congested. Proposed rules would steer large power users to remote areas, possibly from 2027. The article date is inferred (timestamp 7.10., year not shown).

signals.title: Miter raises $40M
signals.detail: Miter, an AI workforce platform for construction, raised $40M in a round led by Battery Ventures. The round was reported by Webull and Pulse, and the series label is uncertain.

signals.title: Buildots raises $130M
signals.detail: The Israeli-founded AI site-monitoring company raised $130M to expand into data centres and industrial facilities. This shows that late-stage capital is available and that data centres are a key vertical.

signals.title: Finland building permits up 19% in volume (12-month, August 2026)
signals.detail: Growth is non-residential-led. Residential recovery lags, and B+L does not expect a sustainable residential recovery before 2027.
